item: La Heroína del Dos de Mayo

messages.text: I'd like to open at 95 P for La Heroína del Dos de Mayo. That reflects a fair price given condition and resale uncertainty, and I'm keen to move efficiently. What figure did you have in mind?
Happy to sell La Heroína del Dos de Mayo for 180 primas, a fair price we can close on right away.
I've moved up to 105 P as a show of good faith. Given the condition and the resale risk I'm taking on, I'd need to see your figure come down meaningfully from where it started. Where can you meet me?
178 P works for me and we can close now.

I've stepped up to 107 P, but a 2 P move from your side isn't a serious step toward me. I need to see a real cut from your figure before I can go further, so what room do you have to come down meaningfully?
Meeting you closer: 176 P.
I can go to 108 P, a small step to match yours. The gap between us is still large, and small moves from either side won't close it. Show me a substantial cut and I'll respond in kind.
A real step from me: 174 P.
I'll move to 109 P, a small step to match yours. Steps of 2 P from where you started won't bridge a gap this size. If you can make a substantive move below 160, I'll respond in kind.
I can do 172 P. Every round costs us both, so let's close.

I'll move to 110 P. Your steps of 2 P leave us very far apart, and each round costs us both, so a real cut is needed. Bring your figure into the 150s and I'll respond with a meaningful move of my own.
170 P works for me and we can close now.
I can move to 111 P. Small steps from either side won't close a gap this size, and every round costs us both. A substantial cut, well into the 150s, would let me respond with a real move of my own.
Meeting you closer: 168 P.

I'll move to 113 P. Steps of 2 P from your side leave a very wide gap, and time and rounds are running down for both of us. A substantially larger cut from you would let me respond with a real move of my own.
A real step from me: 166 P.

I'll make a clear step to 120 P to show I'm serious. Your 2 P steps can't bridge this gap before time runs out, and every round costs us both. If you want to close, I need to see a jump into the 140s now.
I can do 164 P. Every round costs us both, so let's close.
I'll move to 124 P, another step toward you. Your 2 P steps leave a huge gap with few ticks left, so if you want to close, I need to see a big jump into the 140s now.
162 P works for me and we can close now.
I'll make a meaningful step to 132 P. Your 2 P steps won't meet mine before time runs out, and every round costs us both. If you make a real jump now, I'll keep moving toward you.
Meeting you closer: 160 P.

I'll make a clear step to 142 P. I've moved far more than you have over this exchange, and with few ticks left it's your turn to close the gap. Meet me in the mid-140s and we can wrap this up next tick.
I'll make a meaningful move to 150 P, which splits the remaining gap between us. With so few ticks left, meet me there and we can wrap this up.
Meeting you with a big jump: 148 P and we can close right now.
